name: ghostpaw-grimoire
description: Local procedural knowledge with spells, notes, and revision history.
long_description: Local procedural knowledge with spells, notes, and revision history. Stores data in a local SQLite database.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: search_grimoire
tools.description: Search the grimoire for spells by name or description.

tools.name: review_grimoire
tools.description: Review a dashboard view of the grimoire — chapters, health, resonance, notes, drafts, validation, provenance, or index.

tools.name: inspect_grimoire_item
tools.description: Inspect a single spell in detail, including tier, resonance, validation, provenance, and history.

tools.name: inscribe_spell
tools.description: Create a new spell in the grimoire.

tools.name: update_spell
tools.description: Write new content to an existing spell, leaving the change uncommitted.

tools.name: hone_spell
tools.description: Seal pending spell changes into a git commit, advancing spell ranks.

tools.name: manage_spell
tools.description: Manage spells: shelve, unshelve, move, delete, repair, repair all, or rollback to a previous seal.

tools.name: drop_note
tools.description: Drop an observation note into the grimoire for later cataloguing.

tools.name: manage_draft
tools.description: Submit, approve, or dismiss spell drafts.

tools.name: run_catalogue
tools.description: Run the full catalogue maintenance pass — detect stale/dormant/oversized spells, route notes, cluster orphans, compute health.

tools.name: scout_skills
tools.description: Scout, search, adopt, and update spells from external sources.
